title: UN chief backs engagement with Myanmar but ‘violence needs to stop’

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres expressed support Monday for fresh diplomatic efforts to engage with Myanmar’s post-coup government, but said that “violence needs to stop”. Guterres made the remarks in Manila, where leaders from the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) agreed Sunday to pursue a “calibrated engagement” with the war-torn country. Myanmar
